title: Send MSD Request
description: Backs taf_ecall_SendMsd -> ICallManager::updateECallMsd(). Mirrors UpdateECallMsdRequest, which (like MakeECallRequest) never carried MSD bytes on the wire -- only phoneId, since the server only simulates protocol timing (DecodeSendMSD/CRCCheckonMSD/DecodeMSD HLAP states), never MSD content.
